data.value:
MYELOPROLIFERATIVE NEOPLASM (MPN) MOLECULAR PANEL (BCR-ABL, JAK2, CALR, MPL)

Method: Real Time (RT)-PCR

Specimen Type: EDTA whole Blood

S.No.   GENE MUTATION  RESULTS
1.  BCR-ABL1 major (p210)  NOT DETECTED
2.  BCR-ABL1 mino (p190)   NOT DETECTED
3.  MPL W515L  NOT DETECTED
4.  MPL W515K  NOT DETECTED
5.  MPL W515A  NOT DETECTED
6.  MPL S505N  NOT DETECTED
7.  CALR Type1 (L367fs*46)  NOT DETECTED
8.  CALR Type2 (K385fs*47)  NOT DETECTED
9.  JAK2 V617F  DETECTED

 
BACKGROUND:

  • BCR-ABL1 gene rearrangement: Almost all cases of CML except atypical forms are positive for BCR-ABL1 gene rearrangement. 
  • MPL gene mutation: 8% of cases of PMF have mutations in MPL.
  • CALR gene mutation: 30% of cases of PMF have mutations in CALR.
  • JAK2 V617F gene mutation: More than 95% cases of PV and 50-60% cases of PMF and ET are positive for JAK2V617F gene mutation.

 COMMENTS:

  • For fusion genes (BCR-ABL) the LOD is equal to 10 copies of fusion transcript and for MPL, CALR and JAK2 V617F, the LOD is equal to 1% mutant allele in background of 99% wild type allele.
  • This result does not rule out the presence of mutations that may be below the detection limit of the assay.
  • This test detects mutations which are described above only. It does not detect any other mutation.
  • Results are to be interpreted in context of clinical findings other and laboratory data.
  • PCR is a highly sensitive technique, however inherent PCR inhibitors in the specimen can result in amplification failure.
